excerpt.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
excerpt.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

texts.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
texts.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

texts.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
texts.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

texts.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
texts.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

texts.zh: 我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？
texts.en: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?
